rule: This is a prepared evidence queue, not a claim that tasks were inserted into or dispatched by the real Percy host.

tasks.objective: Recover truthful live Percy state from the existing canonical Mac host without resetting or requeueing anything.
tasks.exact_deliverable: PERCY_HOST_RECOVERY_20260814.md + machine-readable snapshot containing SQLite integrity, schema/migration version, task-state counts, lease/heartbeat/process reconciliation, stale/dirty worktree inventory, provider/resource observations, and backup identifier.
tasks.verification_method: Independently compare DB task/worker rows with live PIDs, meaningful commands, heartbeat age and worktree activity; rerun integrity check after any additive migration.
tasks.success_criterion: Previously UNKNOWN live counters are measured from the existing DB and no failed/dirty/stale evidence is lost or blindly requeued.
tasks.failure_criterion: Host/DB unavailable, integrity failure without safe backup, ambiguous canonical DB, or reconciliation cannot prove liveness. Remain blocked; do not reset.
tasks.canonical_artifact_destination: Percy canonical host + mirrored status artifact in control repo after verification

tasks.objective: Resolve why current public smoke passes while Production Health run 31771831538 marks production unhealthy, and prove or disprove exact served revision identity.
tasks.exact_deliverable: VERTEXED_PRODUCTION_INCIDENT_31771831538.md with probe artifact contents, expected revision, served revision/health response when obtainable, deployment mapping, root-cause class, and one next action.
tasks.verification_method: Cross-check health response against intended deploy-relevant commit and rerun bounded production monitor/golden journey only after identity is repaired.
tasks.success_criterion: Exact served revision is verified and production health passes, or one precise external deployment blocker is demonstrated.
tasks.failure_criterion: No revision identity can be established or authenticated journey remains broken; production stays F/BLOCKED.

tasks.objective: Close missing provenance fields for the frozen negative ARC experiment without rerunning or retuning science.
tasks.exact_deliverable: Complete EXP-LAM-ARC-FROZEN-AUDIT registry entry with exact reproduction command, config path/hash, raw/processed artifact paths, figure/table generation commands and commit lineage.
tasks.verification_method: A clean reader can traverse claim -> table -> processed -> raw -> config -> code SHA -> command with no guessed field.
tasks.success_criterion: No UNKNOWN provenance field remains for manuscript results and the negative conclusion is unchanged.
tasks.failure_criterion: Required provenance is absent or inconsistent; flag manuscript blocker rather than regenerate unverifiable history.

tasks.objective: Convert the reproduced negative ARC result into a reviewer-resistant paper evidence package.
tasks.exact_deliverable: Manuscript package with question/hypothesis, related-work TODO map, frozen protocol, five-seed tables, ablations, prediction-collapse/failure analysis, seed-order bug chronology, limitations, reproducibility, figure source data and reviewer attack.
evidence_requirement: every quantitative claim linked to registry provenance
tasks.verification_method: Three-role reviewer attack: novelty skeptic, experimental skeptic, mechanism/confound skeptic; reject any untraced claim.
tasks.success_criterion: PAPER_PACKAGE_GREEN for evidence/provenance, while scientific state remains D_NEGATIVE_RESULT.
tasks.failure_criterion: Unsupported claim, missing provenance, or originality gap large enough to make paper uninformative; downgrade to technical report package.
tasks.canonical_artifact_destination: LAM-JEPA manuscript/reproducibility directory + control-repo paper status

tasks.objective: Recover exact NGMT v0.1 artifact/config/command provenance and freeze the negative B0-B3 result package.
tasks.exact_deliverable: NGMT_V01_NEGATIVE_PACKAGE.md + completed registry fields for exact command/artifact/config/environment, B0-B3 table and failure analysis.
tasks.verification_method: Independent metric recomputation from retained raw outputs; verify no post-result tuning/version mutation.
tasks.success_criterion: Negative result is fully traceable and publication/technical-report boundary is explicit.
tasks.failure_criterion: Raw/config provenance cannot be recovered; retain negative status but mark reproduction package incomplete.

tasks.objective: Reconcile the 14,895-vs-14,899 row provenance discrepancy without changing data/parser to fit prose.
tasks.exact_deliverable: EIGEN_JEPA_PROVENANCE_RECONCILIATION.md documenting dataset source/version, parser logic, excluded/missing rows, old-spec origin, impact on frozen result, and whether any manuscript text must be corrected.
tasks.verification_method: Independent count from the frozen parser/data path; compare result lineage without rerunning to optimize metrics.
tasks.success_criterion: Row discrepancy has a factual explanation or remains a bounded explicit UNKNOWN; no scientific metric is silently changed.
tasks.failure_criterion: Provenance cannot be resolved; paper retains limitation and cannot claim exact historical dataset identity.

tasks.objective: Close the current PABIM line as a negative development-gate package without touching reserved confirmatory seeds.
tasks.exact_deliverable: IRIS_V02_NEGATIVE_RESULT_PACKAGE.md containing frozen question/hypothesis, baseline table, adverse-condition results, shift recovery results, failed gates, bool-serialization repair lineage, limitations and successor rules.
tasks.verification_method: Recompute displayed metrics from retained raw output only; no new candidate tuning or confirmatory evaluation.
tasks.success_criterion: Current mechanism is unambiguously D_NEGATIVE_RESULT and paper/technical-report usefulness can be reviewed separately.
tasks.failure_criterion: Raw evidence cannot support the documented gates; downgrade to inconclusive with exact missing evidence.

tasks.objective: Recover one canonical Project 2424 source and deduplicate proposals/experiments/worktrees into a small child registry.
tasks.exact_deliverable: PROJECT_2424_CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json/md mapping each promoted ID to canonical path/source SHA, type, evidence, verifier, state and duplicate relation; archive all unpromoted variants by default without deleting evidence.
tasks.verification_method: Semantic duplicate review plus path/remote/SHA verification; no alias may become a new project without distinct hypothesis.
tasks.success_criterion: At most a small evidence-backed flagship set remains active, with one authoritative identity per child.
tasks.failure_criterion: Canonical source remains ambiguous; leave projects blocked/unknown rather than merge/delete automatically.
tasks.canonical_artifact_destination: Project 2424 canonical repo + control-repo canonicalization ledger

tasks.objective: Freeze the decisive same-provider direct-vs-structured-IR benchmark before any new model calls.
tasks.exact_deliverable: NEUROCAD_MATCHED_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.json/md with provider/model/version, prompts/information, temperature, token/retry budget, case buckets, metrics, seeds/request IDs, primary effect, falsifier, analysis plan and cost ceiling.
tasks.verification_method: Protocol reviewer checks that both arms receive equivalent information/budget and that success metrics are executable/geometry/constraint based rather than subjective cherry-picking.
tasks.success_criterion: Protocol is frozen and execution-ready without looking at new results.
tasks.failure_criterion: Provider/model/budget cannot be matched or evaluation remains subjective; keep C-state and do not spend calls.
tasks.canonical_artifact_destination: NeuroCAD experiment directory + EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY after execution

tasks.objective: Freeze the same-information learned-memory control that can falsify APEN architecture-specific benefit.
tasks.exact_deliverable: APEN_LEARNED_CONTROL_PROTOCOL.json/md defining no-memory/uniform/recurrent/attention-or-retrieval/APEN arms, capacity/data/optimizer/steps/seeds matching, salience corruption levels, primary metric/effect gate, falsifier and analysis plan.
tasks.verification_method: Independent protocol review for parameter/data/compute equality and same-information controls before execution.
tasks.success_criterion: One decisive learned-control experiment is frozen; no additional synthetic variants are queued.
tasks.failure_criterion: Fair matching cannot be defined with available implementation; document blocker and stop APEN compute.
tasks.canonical_artifact_destination: APEN experiment directory + claim/experiment ledgers after execution
